definitions.explanation: A particular way or system of doing something.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{支払|しはら}い{方式|ほうしき}を{導入|どうにゅう}する。
examples.english: To introduce a new payment system.

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}は{日本|にほん}{方式|ほうしき}で{動|うご}く。
examples.english: This machine operates on the Japanese system.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}{方式|ほうしき}を{変更|へんこう}する。

notes:
{方式|ほうしき} refers to a system, method, or format — a standardized way of doing something. Composed of {方|ほう} (method) + {式|しき} (style, formula).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{方式|ほうしき}: ~-style, ~-type system
- {方式|ほうしき}を{採用|さいよう}する: to adopt a system
- {方式|ほうしき}を{変|か}える: to change the method

EXAMPLES OF ~{方式|ほうしき}:
- {入札|にゅうさつ}{方式|ほうしき}: bidding system
- {選挙|せんきょ}{方式|ほうしき}: electoral system
- {暗号|あんごう}{方式|ほうしき}: encryption method
- {日本|にほん}{方式|ほうしき}: Japanese system/style

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {方法|ほうほう}: method (more general, everyday)
- {形式|けいしき}: format, form (structure/appearance)
- {様式|ようしき}: style (architectural/artistic)
- {制度|せいど}: system, institution (organizational)
